title: DECISION: SessionState enum makes unauthenticated command dispatch impossible
description: reader/session/state.rs models NNTP session state as a three-variant enum: Authenticating, Active, GroupSelected. is_authenticated() and group_selected() predicate methods are derived from the enum. The dispatcher must call these predicates before dispatching any command; there is no way to represent an in-between state where a session is both authenticating and group-selected. Why correct: without a state machine enforcing this, a logic error in the dispatcher could allow commands requiring authentication to be issued from the Authenticating state. The enum makes that class of bug structurally impossible. A future contributor might replace the enum with boolean fields (is_authenticated: bool, group_selected: bool), which allows invalid combinations.
